title: Talk of Alaska: Wildfire Season Prep
text:
Alaska’s wildfire season is underway, and that means Alaskans need to be extra vigilant when working and recreating outdoors to avoid starting unintended burns. Fires are already raging in the Lower 48. What do firefighters think this season might present for Alaska wildfire activity, and how should you prepare your property to keep it safe? Join host Lori Townsend on this Talk of Alaska and hear from fire management experts.
